products.title: Hand-Turned Wooden Pen
products.summary: A smooth, balanced writing instrument turned by hand from distinctive hardwood.
description: Each pen starts as a small block of hardwood. Ed turns it on the lathe, shapes it to sit comfortably in the hand, then sands and finishes it until the grain shows clearly. The result is a pen that's pleasant to write with and good to look at.
Because every blank is different, your pen's grain and color will vary from the photos. Add engraving at checkout for a graduation, retirement, or thank-you gift.
details: [PEN STYLE, e.g. twist ballpoint] with [HARDWARE FINISH] fittings
products.care: Wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth. Keep out of long periods of direct sun and heat. Replace the refill as needed; [HOW TO OPEN THE PEN].

products.title: Hand-Turned Wooden Bowl
products.summary: A one-of-a-kind wooden bowl that celebrates the grain, color, and character of the wood.
description: Every bowl is turned from a single piece of wood and shaped by eye and hand on the lathe. Ed lets the wood guide the final form, so curves, grain lines, and color shifts are unique to your bowl.
Set it out for fruit or bread, or use it as a centerpiece. The photos show the style and finish to expect. Your bowl will have its own grain, and that's the point.
products.finish: [FINISH TYPE]. [FOOD-SAFE NOTE: publish only after Ed confirms the finish and that it is food-safe once cured.]
products.care: Hand wash with mild soap and warm water, then dry right away. Don't soak it or put it in the dishwasher or microwave. Every so often, rub in a little [RECOMMENDED OIL/CONDITIONER] to keep the wood from drying out.

products.title: Handcrafted Cutting Board
products.summary: A durable hardwood cutting board made for everyday prep, serving, and gifting.
description: A good board is the most-used tool in a kitchen. Ed builds each one from solid hardwood, flattens and sands it smooth, and finishes it for daily use: chopping, slicing, and serving.
Choose your size, and consider engraving for a wedding, housewarming, or anniversary. Grain and color vary from the photos because every board is made from real wood.
products.care: Hand wash with warm, soapy water and dry it right away, standing on edge. Don't soak it or put it in the dishwasher. When the surface looks dry, rub in a thin coat of [RECOMMENDED OIL/BOARD CONDITIONER], let it soak in, and wipe off the extra.
